query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(chatter_login, ''), 'unknown') AS "chatter_login!", COUNT(*)::int8 AS "messages!", MIN(message_ts)::text AS first_message_at, MAX(message_ts)::text AS last_message_at FROM twitch_chat_messages WHERE session_id = $1 AND COALESCE(is_command, FALSE) = FALSE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(chatter_login, ''), 'unknown') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20
